recent_publications.title: Perceive with confidence: Statistical safety assurances for navigation with learning-based perception
recent_publications.venue: International Journal of Robotics Research 45(6), 938–967 (first online 2025; issue May 2026)
recent_publications.assessment: Conformal calibration estimates perception uncertainty while accounting for planner-induced state shifts. The abstract reports simulation and quadruped navigation in unseen static indoor environments, with improved empirical safety. The statistical guarantee depends on the method's assumptions; this evidence does not establish safety in arbitrary dynamic or outdoor settings. Review depth: institutional abstract and publisher metadata; proofs, trial counts and code were not independently audited.
recent_publications.review_depth: Abstract and bibliographic metadata
reading_questions: What calibration and distribution assumptions underpin the guarantee?
How are planner-induced state shifts handled?
